angel_ch1_01.speaker: narrator
angel_ch1_01.text: The corridor beyond the garden leads upward. Stone steps, worn smooth by countless feet, spiral into light.

angel_ch1_02.speaker: narrator
angel_ch1_02.text: At the top, a room open to the sky. No ceiling -- just clouds moving slowly overhead, impossibly close. Wind that smells of rain and old paper.

angel_ch1_03.speaker: narrator
angel_ch1_03.text: Someone stands at the edge, their back to you. They are tall, dressed in white that moves like it has a life of its own. Their shoulders are tense -- coiled, like a spring held too long.

angel_ch1_04.speaker: angel
angel_ch1_04.text: You shouldn't be up here. This area is... I keep it private.

angel_ch1_05.speaker: narrator
angel_ch1_05.text: They turn. Their face is sharp, beautiful in a way that makes your chest ache. There's a scar running from their temple to their jaw, pale and old.

choices.text: I'm sorry. I didn't know. I'll go.
I got lost. The stairs just... kept going.
It's beautiful up here. I can see why you come here.
You look like you're carrying something heavy too.

angel_ch1_leave_02.speaker: angel
angel_ch1_leave_02.text: ...You're the new one. The one the garden let in. I should be more -- I should be more welcoming. I'm told I'm not good at that.

angel_ch1_lost_01.speaker: angel
angel_ch1_lost_01.text: They do that. The stairs. This place has a way of taking you where you need to go, whether you asked or not.

angel_ch1_lost_02.speaker: angel
angel_ch1_lost_02.text: I used to fight it. Now I just follow.

angel_ch1_beauty_01.speaker: angel
angel_ch1_beauty_01.text: Something shifts in their expression. The tension in their jaw loosens, just barely.

angel_ch1_beauty_02.speaker: angel
angel_ch1_beauty_02.text: It is. On clear nights you can see things in the sky that don't have names yet. I come here to remember that the world is bigger than the inside of my head.

angel_ch1_mirror_01.speaker: angel
angel_ch1_mirror_01.text: They go very still. For a moment you think you've made a terrible mistake.

angel_ch1_mirror_02.speaker: angel
angel_ch1_mirror_02.text: ...You see that? Most people look at me and see someone who has it together. Strong. Put together. They don't look past it.

angel_ch1_mirror_03.speaker: angel
angel_ch1_mirror_03.text: You're either very perceptive or very reckless. Either way... thank you. For saying it out loud.

angel_ch1_skill_01.speaker: narrator
angel_ch1_skill_01.text:
[Skill Unlocked: Emotional Validation]
Validation means acknowledging someone's feelings as real and understandable -- including your own. You don't have to fix it or explain it. 'That makes sense' and 'I hear you' are complete sentences. Validation isn't agreement; it's recognition.

angel_ch1_converge_01.speaker: angel
angel_ch1_converge_01.text: {angel} gestures to a stone bench overlooking the clouds. They sit on one end, leaving space. An invitation, not an insistence.

angel_ch1_converge_02.speaker: angel
angel_ch1_converge_02.text: I'm not like the others here. The Oracle sees patterns. The Keeper holds memories. I... I used to protect people. That was my purpose.

angel_ch1_converge_03.speaker: angel
angel_ch1_converge_03.text: Then I failed. Badly. And I've been up here since, trying to figure out what I'm for if I can't do the one thing I was made to do.

angel_ch1_converge_04.speaker: narrator
angel_ch1_converge_04.text: The wind picks up. {angel}'s white clothes ripple. For a moment they look like something out of a story -- radiant and broken at the same time.

angel_ch1_converge_05.speaker: angel
angel_ch1_converge_05.text: Sorry. That was -- you just got here. You don't need my baggage on top of your own.

choices.text: You didn't fail. You're still here.
I don't mind. Honestly, it helps to hear I'm not the only one struggling.

angel_ch1_comfort_01.speaker: angel
angel_ch1_comfort_01.text: {angel} looks at you like you've said something in a language they forgot they knew.

angel_ch1_comfort_02.speaker: angel
angel_ch1_comfort_02.text: ...That's the most terrifying kind of kindness. The kind you can't dismiss because it's simple and true.

angel_ch1_shared_01.speaker: angel
angel_ch1_shared_01.text: Funny how that works, isn't it? We think we're the only ones drowning, and then we find someone else treading water, and suddenly it's easier to float.

angel_ch1_shared_02.speaker: angel
angel_ch1_shared_02.text: You might be the first person here who's made me feel less alone. I didn't expect that today.

angel_ch1_skill_02.speaker: narrator
angel_ch1_skill_02.text:
[Skill Unlocked: Social Connection]
Isolation makes pain louder. Connection doesn't erase it, but it changes the acoustics. Sharing your struggle with even one person who understands can reduce the intensity of distress. You don't have to perform being okay.

angel_ch1_ask_01.speaker: angel
angel_ch1_ask_01.text: {angel} is quiet for a long time. The clouds move overhead.

angel_ch1_ask_02.speaker: angel
angel_ch1_ask_02.text: Not today. Not because I don't trust you -- I'm not sure I trust myself to tell it right yet. But... ask me again sometime. When we know each other better.

angel_ch1_evening_01.speaker: narrator
angel_ch1_evening_01.text: The sky begins to change. Deep violet bleeding into gold. Stars appearing one at a time, like someone lighting candles across an enormous ceiling.

angel_ch1_evening_02.speaker: angel
angel_ch1_evening_02.text: You should go back down before it gets dark. The stairs are less cooperative at night.

angel_ch1_evening_03.speaker: angel
angel_ch1_evening_03.text: {name}... come back tomorrow, if you want. I'll be here. I'm always here.

choices.text: You shouldn't always be alone up here.
Can we stay and watch the stars? Just for a little longer?

angel_ch1_end_promise.speaker: angel
angel_ch1_end_promise.text: {angel} nods. Just once. But there's something in that nod that feels like a bridge being built.

angel_ch1_end_concern.speaker: angel
angel_ch1_end_concern.text: {angel} opens their mouth. Closes it. Opens it again.

angel_ch1_end_concern_02.speaker: angel
angel_ch1_end_concern_02.text: You're right. I know you're right. It's just... being alone is easier when you've decided you deserve it.

angel_ch1_skill_03.speaker: narrator
angel_ch1_skill_03.text:
[Skill Unlocked: Recognizing Cognitive Distortions]
'I deserve to be alone' is a thought, not a fact. Cognitive distortions are patterns of thinking that feel true but aren't supported by evidence. Common ones: all-or-nothing thinking, mind reading, personalizing. Noticing the pattern is the first step to loosening its grip.

angel_ch1_end_stars.speaker: angel
angel_ch1_end_stars.text: {angel} doesn't say anything. They just... make room on the bench. Move a little closer. Not touching, but close enough to feel warmth.

angel_ch1_end_stars_02.speaker: narrator
angel_ch1_end_stars_02.text: You watch the sky together in silence. It's not awkward. It's not loaded. It's just two people who understand that some things don't need words.

angel_ch1_end_shared.speaker: narrator
angel_ch1_end_shared.text: Later, back in the warmth of the sanctuary, you lie in the dark and think about the sky. About the scar. About the way someone can look so strong and so fragile at the same time.

angel_ch1_end_final.speaker: narrator
angel_ch1_end_final.text: Your deck pulses softly against your chest. One card feels warmer than the others -- like it's trying to speak. But sleep is already pulling you under, gentle as a tide.
